name: Chattogram District Police — SP office and thanas
attribution: Office of the Superintendent of Police, Chattogram (police.chittagong.gov.bd, chattogramdistrict.police.gov.bd), the thana portals and the Chattogram DC portal
notes: No licence stated. SP office from the Superintendent's officer card on police.chittagong.gov.bd (+ address from 'যোগাযোগ'); the 16 district thanas from the Bangladesh Police site chattogramdistrict.police.gov.bd (one page per thana with the OC's police official mobile), enriched with the office landline and *.gov.bd e-mail of the upazila thana portals police.<upazila>.chittagong.gov.bd. Personal e-mails, other mobiles and officers' names are not copied. Chattogram city is policed by CMP (CHATTOGRAM_METRO_POLICE_THANAS_2026); police.karnafuli.chittagong.gov.bd belongs to CMP's Karnaphuli thana and is not used here.
